title: Support ticket history: code that relies on rows coming back in insertion order
name: Ticket event ordering

questions.prompt: Since the ticket service moved off the in-memory store onto Postgres, agents say ticket timelines are jumbled: replies show up before the customer's question and "closed" appears in the middle. The SLA report also shows some tickets as answered within minutes and others as breached when they weren't. Ticket statuses are still correct. Unit tests against the old in-memory store pass; the new integration tests don't. Fix events.ts so the tests pass.
